community.title: Join the community
community.heading: Connect with WoT players
community.description: Join our Discord to chat WoT stats, request features and report bugs. Or hop on GitHub to inspect the code and contribute.

profiles.title: Player profiles
profiles.description: Detailed stats with overall + 24h / 7d / 30d deltas, WN7, WN8, WNX, and Personal Rating.

clans.title: Clan pages
clans.description: Members table with ratings, recent activity feed, description and clan metadata.

history.title: Clan history
history.description: Full timeline of every clan a player has been in, with roles and dates.

live.title: Live updates
live.description: Tracked players refresh in the background every 24h via our snapshot system.

leaderboards.title: Leaderboards
leaderboards.description: Top players (24h, 7d, all-time) and top clans ranked by WNX, computed from our snapshots.

open-source.title: Open source · AGPL
open-source.description: Code’s on GitHub. Inspect, fork, contribute. No ads, opt-in analytics only.

search.title: 🔍 Search players or clans
search.description: Press {shortcut} to open the search, then type a nickname or clan tag.

region.title: 🌍 Switch region
region.description: Use the {selector} selector in the navbar. Leaderboards update accordingly.

leaderboards.title: 🏆 Browse leaderboards
leaderboards.description: Top players (24h, 7d, all-time) and top clans ranked by average WNX, computed from our snapshots.

colors.title: 📊 Read the colors
colors.description: WR, WN7, WN8 and WNX share the same tier colors (orange → green → cyan → purple). See the scale above.
